power_systems.name: Mana-Based Magic
power_systems.summary: Mages channel mana outward through stabilized circles to produce spells that interact with natural laws.
mechanics: Mana is stored and refined through a core and internal circuits.
Magic circles encode a spell's logic, such as element, range, intensity and duration.
Higher circle counts increase efficiency, complexity and the mage's ability to manipulate natural laws.
Classical specializations include elemental, spirit, healing and illusion magic.

tiers.capabilities: Mana circuit opened; simple elemental orbs and elementary effects.
First circle complete; basic offensive spells and improved casting speed.
Basic combat and utility magic; more stable mana efficiency.
Improved mana attunement; area effects become practical.
Can customize spell formulae and develop personal variants.
Can achieve silent casting without externally visible circles.
Can read and predict mana flow; often compared to Master Entry martial combat potential, though the comparison is approximate.
Deep understanding of magical laws and direct manipulation of natural laws.
Can reinterpret natural laws and develop entirely new magic; extremely rare.

limitations_and_balance: Circle count is not a guarantee of victory: knowledge, matchup, preparation and circumstance matter.
Do not assume a character can use every school of magic merely because they have a high circle rank.

power_systems.name: Martial Cultivation / Aura
power_systems.summary: Martial artists refine mana internally into Aura (also called Qi in some descriptions). Rather than casting outward, they reinforce body, reflexes and weapons.
mechanics: Ambient mana is absorbed and circulated internally.
Internal training converts raw mana into Aura.
Aura enhances strength, speed, durability and reflexes, and can later be channelled into weapons.
At Master ranks, Aura can manifest visibly or be shaped by will.

tiers.capabilities: Basic circulation and slight physical enhancement.
Controlled aura flow; brief enhancement focused on body parts.
Stable full-body Aura circulation and consistent physical enhancement.
Combines inner and outer control; weapon coating and early sword energy may emerge.
Refined sword energy and reduced strain through deep understanding; a major plateau.
Aura visibly manifests; unique Sword Aura appears, but sustained use is physically taxing.
Sword Aura becomes stable and sustainable; body and Aura work in harmony.
Transcendent mastery in which will can shape Aura; extraordinarily rare.

power_systems.name: Holy Power / Divinity
power_systems.summary: A power source distinct from mana, associated primarily with Lily and the Holy Kingdom of Dominus.
mechanics: Channelled through faith, prayer, rituals, sacred oaths and blessed objects.
Common manifestations include healing, purification, barriers and holy attacks.
Especially effective against demonic or corrupted entities in the public reference.
Its strength is not ranked by magic circles; devotion, divine favour and individual spiritual capacity are described as factors.

terms.saintess: A mortal described as an exceptional conduit of divine power.
terms.holy_knight: A combatant who combines martial training with divine blessing.
terms.inquisitor: A religious investigator or combat specialist associated with Dominus.

power_systems.name: Miasma
power_systems.summary: A cursed power associated with Delphirem, the Abyss Zone and the Demon God Cult. It is distinct from ordinary mana and is described as corruptive.
mechanics: Associated with the Abyss Zone and the Demon God Delphirem.
Can corrupt mana circuits; prolonged exposure may affect body and mind.
Cult members access it through pacts, rituals or offerings.
Sin Bishops are described as receiving power comparable to a 7-Circle mage through pacts; Apostles operate at still higher levels.
narrative_constraints: Do not use Miasma as a generic synonym for mana.
Cult activity should usually involve motive, preparation, concealment or consequences rather than random attacks.
A pact should have a meaningful price or risk.

power_systems.name: Spirit Magic
power_systems.summary: A magical tradition involving interaction with and/or summoning of spirits. Sia is the standout character associated with four elemental spirits.
mechanics: Details are not exhaustively specified by the sources.
Do not invent exact spirit names, personalities or contracts as established lore unless established in the current campaign.

cross_system_rule: Mana-based magic and martial Aura use the same broad resource concept differently: mages direct power outward through spell constructs; martial artists refine and circulate it inward. Divinity and Miasma are distinct power sources and should not be silently reduced to ordinary mana.
scaling_warning: Power-tier comparisons in source material are approximate. Resolve confrontations using context, skills, preparation, injuries, terrain and narrative stakes rather than rank alone.
